recentItems.title: The Taste Keepers Episode 1 | Pervin Irani on Famous Parsi Food, Recipes & Heritage
recentItems.description:
Food across the world evolves every day, every minute. But the legacy of food across various communities in India carries a flavourful history, and we are absolutely obsessed with that.

Zee Zest presents "The Taste Keepers", a series that brings forth the heartwarming history of food by taking us back in time through the gatekeepers who proudly preserve these traditions every single day.

Our first episode features Parveen Irani, who whipped up some delicious Parsi dishes, served generous dollops of Parsi food legacy and cultural history that were even more tempting.

Stay tuned for the next lip-smacking episode of The Taste Keepers.
